From checkout to the turnstile in four steps

1

Pick your match

Choose the fixture, category and number of seats. Live availability, no surprises.

2

Pay with M-Pesa

Approve an STK Push prompt or pay via our Till. We only issue tickets after verified payment.

3

Get your QR ticket

Your digital ticket appears instantly in My Tickets — download or print it for the gate.

4

Scan & enjoy

Our entry staff scan your QR at the gate. Each ticket admits one holder, once.

Buy with confidence

Every order is validated on our servers, every payment is verified before tickets are issued, and every ticket carries a unique, single-use QR code. If a payment fails, your seats are simply released — you are never charged for a failed prompt.

No hidden feesVerified M-Pesa paymentsSingle-use QR ticketsData Protection Act 2019 aligned
